category_title: Medium-proficiency students who struggle with run-on sentences and L1/L2 translation issues
scenario_title: Writing a journal post and peer comment on Blackboard
minimal_context: The student is logging into the Blackboard learning system to write a reflective journal post and leave comments for their mixed-proficiency peer group.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please log into Blackboard and write your peer comment for your group members, then complete your own journal reflection about the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I will post my comment to my group member first. I wrote: 'As an international student, I understand that writing is hard, especially with second language. I understand how hard to organize thoughts and choose the correct words. I ’m from Korea. In Kore a, it is more important to write in correct grammar too. They don't teach how to organize thoughts and write an essay.'

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Thank you for sharing that with your group. Now, please write your own journal reflection about your experience with the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I will write about the good things first. The good thing is that I felt tha t writing is interesting. I don’ t have perfect grammar skills or writing skills, but when I wrote about personal narrative assignment, I felt that writing was fun. I just need to practice more on grammer and use of English language.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, please continue your reflection. What else do you want to add about your experience?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I will add the bad things. Because of the problems with use of English language, I lost confidence in writing. Writing was very hard as I imagined. Since I am not a good talker, I had troubles with expressing my thoughts in a proper way. This was all bad thing during this assignment.

task.content: Writing a journal post and peer comment on Blackboard

context.environment: Online through the university Blackboard learning system
context.social_setting: Groups of three, each comprising of a high, medium and a low level student
context.time_context: A separate day, typically the day after their final submission

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When reflecting on the emotional impact of linguistic barriers and lack of confidence during the assignment
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Admitted to losing confidence and being a bad talker, but also expressed that writing was fun and interesting despite imperfect grammar
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Felt that writing is interesting and fun, but lost confidence due to problems with use of English language
related_quotes: Because of the problems with use of English language, I lost confidence in writing.
The good thing is that I felt tha t writing is interesting.

behavior_patterns.condition: When interacting with peers of different proficiency levels
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Provides empathetic feedback to group members, comparing educational backgrounds and shared L2 writing struggles
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Feels empathy and understanding towards peers facing similar challenges
related_quotes: As an international student, I understand that writing is hard, especially with second language.
